newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Sept wholesale sales down on year earlier.
newsitem.headline: German Sept wholesale sales down on year earlier.

text.p: German wholesale sales recovered slightly in September against August, but were still down on a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said on Friday.
September wholesale sales were up by a seasonally-adjusted 0.7 percent against August, when they fell by 1.1 percent.
But year-on-year wholesale sales were down by 1.2 percent in real terms after a fall of 3.1 percent in August, the data showed.

Cumulative data for the first nine months showed that wholesale sales were down by one percent against the same period in 1995, with raw materials, semi-finished goods and farm produce weaker. Machinery and equipment sales were up.
